examples.name: Default
examples.summary: The Contact page band: Sales and Support lanes, Support with its system status link, over three self-serve channels. Edit the props in the Controls panel — a band with no lanes and no channels renders nothing.

examples.name: Secondary action
examples.summary: The Sales lane leads with its action and adds an outlined second button; two channels share the frame under the lanes, and the band carries an anchor for #hash links.
